summary:
Implemented the rich_measure feature. Changes: (1) rich/tree.py: added Measurement import and Tree.__rich_measure__, an iterative stack-based walk that measures each label with the unreduced max_width plus 4 cells per indent level. (2) rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__ and the VerticalCenter class (render_lines with pad=False, top/bottom newline-only padding from console.size.height, measurement delegated to the wrapped renderable). (3) CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased with an Added subheading containing the two new entries and the existing markdown entry. (4) tests/test_tree.py: Measurement import and a tree measurement test expecting Measurement(11, 19). (5) tests/test_align.py: VerticalCenter import, repr test, VerticalCenter rendering test (print with end="" expecting "

foo


" at height 6), and measurement test expecting (3, 3). Not done: the secondary Align width and print justify behaviors (not judged, not needed). Tests were not run per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
